identified.en: placed at Cuttack, the Gaṅga capital (approximate)

blurb.en: Ulugh Khān's raid from Tilang on the Gaṅga kingdom of Orissa (1324), which brought back forty elephants.
blurb.hi: तिलंग से उलुग़ ख़ान का ओडिशा के गंग राज्य पर धावा (1324), जो चालीस हाथी ले आया।

reading: there took forty elephants, with which he returned to JTilang.

page.en: H. M. Elliot and John Dowson, The History of India as told by its own Historians (1871), p. 234
page.hi: H. M. Elliot and John Dowson, The History of India as told by its own Historians (1871), पृ. 234
